fusions.name: Fibred Spatter
fusions.desc: Flicks horsehair plaster ahead of you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles in front, with a 15% chance to leave each one [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Drawn Taut
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 14 damage, leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Bristled Render
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Lath and Lime
fusions.desc: Conjures a coat of lime plaster: your armour rises by 10% and then by a further 4%, every hit on you is reduced by 2, and 8% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.
